title: Early Termination Charge on Paloma Business Downgrades
content:
**Termination clause.** The early termination charge of a downgrade of a Paloma Business account is the plan's early-termination months times the committed plan's monthly fee, rounded half up to the cent. Expressed in its parts: the months charged are the plan's early-termination months; each month charged is priced at the committed plan's monthly fee (the month price); the months charged multiplied by the month price give the gross termination charge; and the early termination charge is the gross termination charge rounded half up to the cent, never below 0.00.

**Outside the commitment.** A downgrade scheduled on a plan with no commitment end date, or on or after the commitment end date, carries no early termination charge, that is 0.00.

**Closure.** A closure taking effect before the commitment end date carries the plan's early-termination months times the committed plan's monthly fee.

### Condition and result

| Day the downgrade is scheduled | Early termination charge |
|---|---|
| Plan has no commitment end date | 0.00 |
| On or after the commitment end date | 0.00 |
| Before the commitment end date | Months charged multiplied by the month price, rounded half up to the cent |

### Worked figures (hypothetical accounts)

1. A Paloma Business Scale account (early-termination months 3, monthly fee 299.00 USD) schedules a downgrade before its commitment end date: 3 months multiplied by 299.00 gives a gross termination charge of 897.00 USD, and the early termination charge is 897.00 USD.
2. A Paloma Business Enterprise account (3 months, monthly fee 749.00 USD) schedules a downgrade before its commitment end date: 2247.00 USD.
3. A commitment end date of 10 March: a downgrade scheduled on 9 March is before it and carries the charge; one scheduled on 10 March is on the end date and carries 0.00.
4. A Paloma Business Pro account, whose plan has no commitment end date, schedules a downgrade: 0.00.
